prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 9 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, Day, bright daylight from large windows.
Image 1: the character sheet of Su Yaqing (27)
Image 2: the character sheet of 林青羽 (21), look S0
Image 3: the location SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 9: the prop video-calling phone; use only structure, material, and color
Image 10: the prop glass; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Su Yaqing sits upright in the middle of the cream sofa, the tossed pastel cushion beside her, holding the video-calling phone up close to her face with a sly smile. The kitchen doorway at the back of the room behind the sofa is empty.
Panel 1: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level. Su Yaqing's sly smile drops into a pout, her mouth closed.
Panel 2: Medium shot, high angle over the glass coffee table. Su Yaqing flops back into the pastel cushions with a sigh, mouth closed.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, low angle. Su Yaqing purses her lips and shrugs, mouth closed.
Panel 4: Medium shot, locked-off camera from beyond the coffee table, eye-level. Su Yaqing raises her free palm in mock surrender.
Panel 5: Close-up, slow push in, eye-level. Su Yaqing's face softens and she nods slowly.
Panel 6: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Su Yaqing onto the phone screen, eye-level. Su Yaqing's hand tightens around the phone in the foreground.
Panel 7: Medium close-up, low angle. Su Yaqing gives the phone a warm, loyal smile.
Panel 8: Wide shot, rack focus: the focus shifts from Su Yaqing on the sofa in the foreground to the kitchen doorway at the back, eye-level. Behind the sofa, Lin Qingyu has stepped into the kitchen doorway holding a glass of water, quietly listening while Su Yaqing talks into the phone.
Panel 9: Medium close-up, slow push in on Lin Qingyu in the kitchen doorway, eye-level. Lin Qingyu lowers the glass from his lips, and a knowing smile spreads across his face.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
